name: Hofburg Innsbruck
kurzbeschreibung: The former residence of the **Tiroler** princes impresses with its opulent **Prunksälen**, the grand **Riesensaal**, and a museum.
beschreibung: Hofburg Innsbruck – With its impressive history and architecture, Hofburg Innsbruck ranks among the most significant cultural landmarks in the Innsbruck region. The former residence of the Tyrolean princes captivates with its opulent state halls, the Giants' Hall (*Riesensaal*), and a museum showcasing the fascinating blend of historical heritage and modern presentation. Interactive exhibits make the visit engaging for children and teenagers alike. A museum shop and café complete the experience. Nestled picturesquely in the Innsbruck region, Hofburg is surrounded by landscapes worth traveling for in their own right. The perfect mix of cultural enjoyment and natural beauty makes it a must-visit year-round, whether in summer or winter.
